scope: Live wall-clock playback, every action in near and six-actor/crowd views in both phone viewports. Emulated mobile touch/DPR2; renderer caps raster DPR at1.5. Benchmark harness restarts one-shot actions on the next animation frame so stopped playback is not counted as slow rendering. This is not an authored seamless loop. Chromium ANGLE SwiftShader, software renderer. CPU submission times are not GPU timings. No physical phone FPS claim.
